name: Darktable
tagline: Professional open-source photography workflow and non-destructive RAW developer
description: Darktable is an open-source photography workflow application and RAW developer. A virtual lighttable and darkroom for photographers, it manages your digital negatives in a database and lets you view them through an interactive lighttable.
features: Non-destructive editing workflow across 4x32-bit floating point buffers
Color management support with ICC profile loading
Advanced masking, filmic tone curve, and lens correction
requirements: Linux x86_64 or aarch64, OpenCL GPU support recommended
